audio.transcript: So hear me out. This is my mango ginger chicken plate with green rice and a simple bell pepper salad and let me tell you, this is going to be your next lunch or dinner. It is so fire. This is crazy. And this is so good. All right, so we're going to start with the mango ginger marinade. It's sweet, bright, gingery, but it still has the perfect savory balance. We're going to save about half a cup for later and then we're going to pour the rest all over the chicken and then let that marinate. Next, we're going to thread it onto some skewers and then we're going to set it aside for as long as you want. Overnight is best. Now for the salad, we're going to just toss together some bell peppers, cucumber, mango, red onion, some fresh mint. Let's splash a rice vinegar, some chili flakes, then just give that a good toss. So I'm cooking my skewers on a grill pan, but you can definitely throw these on an outdoor grill and get them nice and charred. Brush on some of that reserved mango ginger sauce. Now this green rice is so simple but so good. I just blended some cilantro, scallion with some other ingredients, then mixed it right into some cooked jasmine rice. This is crazy flavorful and honestly, it's one of those meals you'll keep coming back to.
